reviewConclusions.principal: Only the server-stored reviewer role maps portalRole admin or parent to the public view with reviewOnly=true and assigned studentIds. Client role, reviewOnly, googleUid and studentIds overrides do not grant authority. Invalid or missing reviewer portal roles fail closed.
reviewConclusions.identity: Google credentials still require fixed accounts:lookup verification. Pending email binds to the verified UID only after valid route, entry, scope and workbook checks. email:-prefixed UIDs and reviewer legacy-key authentication are refused.
reviewConclusions.environment: Reviewer authentication and provisioning require ACCEPTANCE_REVIEW_SPREADSHEET_ID from Script Properties to exactly equal the bound Spreadsheet.getId(). Missing, blank, wrong or padded values fail closed. Request parameters cannot enable this gate.
reviewConclusions.readScope: Both reviewer views filter students and rides using authoritative assigned studentIds. The public admin view does not receive the ordinary full-admin bypass in canAccess_.
reviewConclusions.mutationScope: Booking, cancellation, completion and ticket addition check authoritative student IDs. Booking and purchase ID collisions/replays also check the stored target's scope. Only the admin view can complete rides or add tickets.
reviewConclusions.fullAdminSeparation: Reviewer views cannot create students, list invitations, read managed users, change users or delete users. These handlers require full admin and reject reviewOnly.
reviewConclusions.lockRecheck: After acquiring the script lock, nonlogin actions reread the allowlist and reconstruct the current principal from the verified Google UID. Moving the same internal ID to another UID, reassigning scope, demoting the role or disabling the workbook gate cannot preserve previous write authority.
reviewConclusions.replayAndTransactions: Stable booking/purchase IDs, completion/cancellation replay, dedicated Calendar checks, write-ahead pending guard, rollback and uncertain-result retention remain covered by the passing original74 cases.
reviewConclusions.provisioning: Full admin reviewer registration validates workbook gate, existing assigned students and entry IDs. Revision checks, duplicate email/scope checks, self-protection and retention of a linked real administrator remain. Parent/reviewer conversion preserves a valid entry unless explicitly rotated.
reviewConclusions.unattendedTwoViews: GAS-75 and GAS-79 exercise both portal views with one verified UID and unchanged registration, without an administrator changing its role during the sequence. No date scheduling requirement is introduced by this backend change. Actual frontend and live fixed-URL behavior remain separate validation.
